summary: Transition ObsidianAI from Team to Enterprise plan, reallocate seats, enable SCIM/SSO, and reconcile proration
description:
Issue summary: Research team has been using ObsidianAI on the Team plan (monthly seats) and wants to move to the Enterprise plan with SCIM/SSO and dedicated invoicing. Request includes: 120 concurrent seats moved to Enterprise, 40 temporary burst seats for a 6-week research sprint, KMS-approved contract language for BYOK, and proration/credit reconciliation for existing Team-plan invoice.

Background: ObsidianAI was evaluated in Q4 and provisioned under a monthly Team subscription (50 seats billed). Usage spiked and the Research org purchased 120 additional ad-hoc seats on the Team plan. Finance wants a single enterprise invoice with cost center tagging. Legal requires BYOK/KMS clause approved. IT requires SCIM/Okta provisioning and an SSO test before bulk-provisioning.

Impact: Without migration, seat churn and manual provisioning will continue, causing inaccurate billing and limited auditability. Research sprint needs burst seats by 2026-03-20. Procurement should avoid double-billing and secure proration credit for months already paid.

Requested change: 1) Execute upgrade to ObsidianAI Enterprise plan, effective 2026-03-15, covering 120 permanent seats. 2) Add 40 transient seats (expiring 2026-04-30) as burst seats on same enterprise contract with automatic deprovisioning. 3) Enable SCIM + Okta SSO + BYOK KMS integration. 4) Finance: reconcile Team-plan payments and apply proration/credit for overlap. 5) Provide consolidated invoice to Cost Center 7003 and set billing tags.

Acceptance criteria: - Obsidian account shows Enterprise license and billing assigned to Redwood (cost center 7003). - 120 seats provisioned via SCIM on sync schedule and 40 burst seats active by 2026-03-20. - SSO test completed (success criteria: test user SSO login + SCIM create/delete + group sync). - Purchase order/contract executed and stored in Vendor Contracts Confluence page. - Proration/credit reflected on next Redwood invoice or finance memo.

Attachments/links: - Vendor quotes and draft contract: https://vendor-obsi.example.com/quote/RED-3245 - Slack thread: #procurement (link: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234ABC) - Related internal policy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/finance/vendor-onboarding
steps: 1) Confirm final enterprise SKU and per-seat price with ObsidianAE rep (Sonia Marcos).
2) Request Legal to add BYOK clause and sign NDAs (point Legal contact: Mariana Ortiz).
3) Procurement to issue PO and set billing cost center 7003.
4) IT to schedule Okta test with Research test user and enable SCIM mapping (attribute mapping: email, displayName, department).
5) Finance to verify proration calculation and communicate credit to vendor.
6) Confirm auto-deprovision date for 40 burst seats (2026-04-30) and add to contract appendix.
